name: Will insulating my garage keep it warm without a heater?

mainEntity.name: Will insulating my garage keep it warm without a heater?

acceptedAnswer.text: Insulation slows heat transfer and keeps temperatures from swinging wildly, but it does not generate heat on its own. In an unheated garage, insulation helps retain residual heat from cars or adjoining conditioned rooms, keeping the area noticeably warmer than the outdoors in winter. However, if you want a constant room temperature of 65 to 70 degrees during cold winter months, you will need to pair the insulation with a supplemental space heater or mini-split system.
acceptedAnswer.description: Insulation slows heat loss and keeps the garage noticeably milder than outside, but maintaining comfortable room temperatures requires a heat source.
